description: Saves and publishes the banner look for a website on the confirmed account: colours (for example the suggested banner colours from a site analysis), position, layout, font and privacy policy URL. Returns a preview link to the CookiePilot panel.

colors.description: CSS colours (hex or rgb/rgba); missing keys keep their current value

hostname.description: Website hostname, e.g. example.com; defaults to the website given to create_account

privacy_policy_url.description: Link to the site's privacy policy

name: configure_banner
title: Configure the cookie banner
